observations: Photo 0: an orange gas cylinder wrapped in a protective netting/mesh sleeve, sitting on a grey sofa/couch, indoor setting.
Photo 0: embossed text near the cylinder collar is visible but not legible enough to read any capacity or certification marking.
Photo 1: top-down view of the cylinder showing a regulator fitted on the valve, with a small label on the regulator body that is too small/blurry to read.
No visible manufacturer stamp, test/inspection date, or SON/NMDPRA certification mark in either photo.
No scale, tape measure, or weighing shot provided to confirm the stated 12.5kg size.
Cylinder paint looks uniform orange with no visible dents, rust, or scorch marks in the limited angles shown.

claims.evidence: No embossed capacity marking or scale is legible in photo 0 or photo 1; size looks plausible for a 12.5kg cylinder but cannot be confirmed.
Photo 1 shows a regulator fitted on the cylinder valve.
This is a sales term, not something photos can confirm or deny.

risks.risk: Cylinder may be expired or lack valid safety recertification (test/manufacture date stamp).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the embossed collar showing manufacture date and last test/inspection date.

risks.risk: Actual gas capacity could differ from the claimed 12.5kg (could be a smaller/larger cylinder).
risks.proof: Photo of the embossed capacity marking on the cylinder neck, or a weighing shot.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed capacity, worst case treated as smallest common size

risks.risk: Valve or cylinder body could have corrosion, dents, or leaks hidden under the netting.
risks.proof: Photo of the cylinder with netting removed, all sides visible, plus a soap-water leak test clip on the valve.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unverified, treated as used/risk of leak

risks.risk: Regulator could be faulty, incompatible, or missing safety certification.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of regulator brand/model label, and a clip showing it mounted and holding pressure.
risks.if_unproven: priced as regulator untested, treated as non-working

risks.risk: Cylinder could be used/refurbished rather than new, despite appearing new in low-detail photos.
risks.proof: Full unobstructed photos from multiple angles without netting, showing any wear marks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used condition, not new

proof_requests: Close-up of the embossed capacity and manufacture/test date stamp on the cylinder collar.
Photo with the protective netting removed, showing the full body from multiple angles.
Close-up of the regulator's brand/model label.
A short video or soap-water test clip showing the valve and regulator connection holding pressure without leaks.
response.reason: The item is clearly a 12.5kg-type gas cylinder with a regulator attached, but no capacity marking, certification date, or leak/pressure test is visible, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified-condition, uncertified cylinder with an untested regulator.
